title: Features
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
Prerequisites

You have to enter a disconnection in the system before you can enter a reconnection.

Features

You enter a reconnection in the same manner as entry of a disconnection. (|#Customer service » Process execution
Disconnection/reconnection » Change disconnection document)

Activities

Reconnections are usually entered using the Change disconnection document transaction. However, you can also enter a

reconnection as a workflow step.

1 Note

The optionally generated service order is confirmed directly in Service Management. You can also branch to Service
Management directly from the reconnection entry.

Monitoring Disconnection and Reconnection Activities

Use

You can execute the Monitoring for Disconnection/Reconnection Orders report, which allows you to search for disconnection or
reconnection orders, monitor their status and access all corresponding screens (for example, object information, work order
information) related to these orders .

Activities

1. Access the corresponding screen by way of the SAP Easy Access menu ( |+UtilitiesIndustry >» CustomerService
ProcessExecution » Disconnection/ Reconnection » Monitor Disconnection Orders 3 ).

2. Specify the selection criteria for the orders you wish to monitor.

3. Choose the Execute button to run the monitoring report.

For more information on the selection criteria, refer to the corresponding report documentation, which you can access from the

selection screen.

If you are working in an advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) environment and are disconnecting or reconnecting AMI devices
(such as advanced meters or smart meters), you can monitor the status of the disconnection or reconnection request and all
messages made between the system and the meter data unification and synchronization (MDUS) system. For more information,

see AMI Monitoring .

Rescheduling of Disconnection and Reconnection Orders
